title: Retry, exponential backoff, and the request that must not repeat

videos.script:
A request fails. Do you send it again? {{table}} It depends on what came back. No answer, or a busy server, is worth another try. A refusal is an answer, and the same bytes get the same no.

Then, how long to wait. {{herd}} If every phone waits the same second, every phone comes back in the same second. So the wait doubles, up to a cap, and each phone picks a random point below it. {{spread}} The same retries, spread out.

The server can also say how long. {{header}} Retry-After, and the client listens.

And the end of the lesson is a warning. {{twice}} The server saves a session, and the answer is lost on the way back. The retry saves it again. One tap, two sessions, and no error anywhere.
